items.title: Cripple a Blood Eagle's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to The Kill Box and aim at the arm with a rifle, using V.A.T.S. for easier targeting.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops team and enter the operation from World Activity on the map.

items.title: Cripple a Human's Head
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant or Lucky Hole Mine for dense groups of human cultists.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of an Eyebot
items.detail: Fast travel to 98 NAR Regional, find an Eyebot, and photograph it with your Camera equipped.

items.title: Collect a tin of Imitation Seafood
Eat a tin of Imitation Seafood
Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your shelter, open the build menu, select Decorations category, and place any decoration.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source. Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is recommended for combining with other challenges.

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect from world loot or craft diluted forms at a chemistry station with Purified Water.

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Use a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron or find soap in the bathrooms of Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take a board game from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. if you have one placed.

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest a raw vegetable like Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain from your C.A.M.P. or Billings Homestead and eat it.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Pint-Sized Phantoms are seasonal cultists. Kill one inside Daily Ops; you don't need to complete the operation.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find an active Infestation on your map and kill Phantoms within the marked area.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days during the week.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events have a chance to spawn mutated variants with additional rewards from mutated packages.

events.name: Double SCORE Weekend and Murmrgh's Special Pick
events.description: Earn double Scoreboard points during this weekend while Murmrgh offers a special legendary weapon rotation.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build and display your best Slasher-themed C.A.M.P. decoration for a community contest.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: A spooky seasonal event featuring new rewards and Halloween-themed activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this special weekend fishing event.
